First Time with Simba

First times. Full commitment.

Made withSimba
Our partConcept · Visual identity · Direction · Distribution

Here’s the idea.

Joel D’Souza tries something completely new, with all the uncertainty that comes with it.

This multi-episode YouTube series follows first-time experiences: an overnight stay at a haunted fort, sailing, extreme food challenges, and entering a bodybuilding competition.

We built an entertainment format around humour, chaos, and genuine surprise. The show’s visual identity and distribution carried the premise across YouTube and Instagram.

An unfamiliar situation gives a familiar personality somewhere new to go.
